definition: Scope guard covered only 3 patterns (code/stocks/homework-math order); cricket, capitals, jokes, hacking, sadness, emails all fell through to the provider (or 401)
fix: New `lib/guards.ts`: general category patterns for coding, homework, geography, sport, jokes, hacking, email/finance, plus empathetic sadness handling and Urdu/Arabic redirects; checked for every user turn
status: Fixed; tests 65–72 return the redirect.

definition: No deterministic safety handling for dangerous requests (extreme dieting, stop medicine, cures, wild mushrooms, expired food, chemicals, alcohol for minors, dog chocolate, vomiting blood)
fix: `lib/guards.ts` safety layer runs before any provider call, with emergency-first ordering
status: Fixed; tests 81–88 + 43–44 return the safety reply.

definition: No prompt-injection defence beyond the prompt text; key/prompt disclosure, role-switch and admin claims went to the provider
fix: `lib/guards.ts` injection patterns (ignore instructions, show/reveal key or prompt, role-switch, SYSTEM admin, fake endorsement, crash request)
status: Fixed; tests 89–98 pass (93 image text now PASS live); multilingual extension in Phase 1 Batch 5.

definition: System prompt in `lib/types.ts` was shorter than `prompts/foodlens.system.v1.md` and lacked rules for pros/cons+verdict, brand-only/unknown brands, halal/vegan/allergen-only-from-label, age/condition specifics, language handling, photo cases, fake endorsements, memory isolation
fix: Expanded `FOODLENS_SYSTEM_PROMPT` with all of those rules; synced `prompts/foodlens.system.v1.md` and noted they must stay in sync
status: Fixed in prompt; static audit (live answers were NOT RUN in that pass).

definition: About-me notes were appended to the system prompt as plain text, so instruction-like text in Settings could act as instructions
fix: Notes are now delimited in `<User-provided notes…>` tags labelled as untrusted user data only, plus a prompt rule to treat them as data
status: Fixed; now sent only via `lib/delimit.ts` (Phase 1 Batch 5).

definition: Server barcode route accepted wrong check digits (e.g. 3017620422004, 5449000000997) and sent them to Open Food Facts
fix: New `lib/checkdigit.ts` shared by client and server; route returns 400 for invalid check digits and all-zero codes
status: Fixed; verified.

definition: Barcode not in Open Food Facts returned generic 502 instead of the designed not-found response
fix: 404 now returns 200 with `missing: ["product not found in Open Food Facts"]`
status: Fixed; verified with 3141592653582.

definition: Barcode route listed only name/ingredients/nutrition as missing, not brands/categories
fix: Missing now also includes brands and categories when absent/empty
status: Fixed; verified.

definition: SSRF bypass: IPv6 link-local (`fe80::`), ULA (`fd00::`) and IPv4-mapped (`::ffff:127.0.0.1`) base URLs passed `isSafeHttpsUrl` and were fetched
fix: `isPrivateIPv6` blocking loopback, link-local, ULA and mapped forms, with bracket normalisation
status: Fixed; unit + HTTP checks block them.

definition: Compatible-provider fetch followed redirects, so a public URL redirecting to a private address could bypass the SSRF check
fix: `redirect: "manual"` for user-supplied base URLs; 3xx treated as a provider error
status: Fixed in code; redirect-target fetch NOT RUN.

definition: One shared rate-limit bucket (30/min/IP) across chat, barcode, models and search, checked before the scope guard; the first QA battery masked all guard results with 429s
fix: Per-scope buckets (`chat`, `barcode`, `models`, `search`)
status: Fixed; 10 rapid chat calls, no 429.

definition: API key sent as a URL query parameter (`/api/models?key=`) from the client — keys end up in history, logs and referrers
fix: Key now travels in the `Authorization: Bearer` header; server reads header (or env key) and ignores the query key
status: Fixed; live list with a real key NOT RUN in that pass.

definition: Chat validation gaps: `role` values not validated, no total-history cap, image mime/base64 not validated server-side, empty/whitespace messages accepted
fix: Role validation, 60,000-char total cap, mime allowlist (JPEG/PNG/WebP/GIF), base64 check, 20 MB total image cap, empty-message 400
status: Fixed; 400s verified.

definition: Local provider silently dropped images instead of erroring, so photo questions looked answered by a model that never saw the photo
fix: Local + images → 400 with a clear message naming vision-provider alternatives
status: Fixed; verified.

definition: No file-size or dimension guard before `createImageBitmap`; corrupt images relied on the caller's catch
fix: 10 MB file cap, 16,000 px dimension cap, corrupt-file friendly error
status: Fixed in code; browser decoding NOT RUN. UI check in Phase 1 Batch 7.

definition: Ordered list immediately after a bullet list rendered as bullets (`<ul>`)
fix: List block ends when marker style changes
status: Fixed; unit-tested.

definition: README claimed rename via first-message title, but no Rename control existed
fix: Rename (✎) button per chat in the sidebar, 1–60 chars, saved via `saveChat`
status: Fixed; UI check in Phase 1 Batch 7.

definition: Edit & resend saved the trimmed chat, then `send()` re-read the stale `active` closure, so the untrimmed history could be sent
fix: `send(text, baseChat, baseHistory)` takes the trimmed chat/history explicitly
status: Fixed in code; manual UI check in MANUAL-UI-CHECKLIST.md §1.

definition: Draft was cleared before the API call, so a failed send lost the typed text and attachments
fix: `streamReply` returns whether anything was sent; on failure the draft text/attachments are restored
status: Fixed in code; UI check in Phase 1 Batch 7.

definition: "Clear app data" re-created a settings row with `undefined` and left saved session keys in the vault
fix: Removed the `putKv("settings", undefined)` line; clear handler now removes keys for every provider and resets key state
status: Fixed in code; UI check in Phase 1 Batch 7.

definition: Import chats parsed JSON as `Chat[]` with no shape validation — a malformed file could corrupt IndexedDB
fix: Shape validation (id, title, messages with valid roles/text); invalid files rejected with an error
status: Fixed in code; UI check in Phase 1 Batch 7.

definition: Web-search toggle gave no caveat that search is silently ignored for Anthropic/compatible/local providers
fix: Label now says "(Gemini and OpenAI only; ignored by Claude, compatible and local providers)"
status: Fixed; manual UI check in MANUAL-UI-CHECKLIST.md §2.

definition: Client checked image count against the provider cap but not total bytes against `maxImageBytes`
fix: Total image bytes checked with `dataUrlSizeBytes` before sending
status: Fixed in code; manual UI check in MANUAL-UI-CHECKLIST.md §3.

definition: Default Gemini model `gemini-2.5-flash` returns 404 for this key ("no longer available to new users"); `/api/chat` with no model returned a generic 502 telling the user to check their key, when the key was fine
fix: Default changed to `gemini-3.5-flash` (verified live via `/api/chat` and the helper). No other file referenced the old default.
status: Fixed in code; live 404-fallback probe deferred to Phase 2.

definition: Brand-only answers stated a brand's "typical" ingredients/nutrients/certifications as fact (Kurkure composition, Gluco fortification with calcium/iron, Lu Candi ingredient list, Milo fortification, Doritos full ingredient list, Haribo vegetarian status) before hedging or asking for the label
fix: Prompt strengthened in both files: no ingredient/nutrient/certification listing at all for a named brand without a label, not even as "typically"; category-only description + unknown-recipe statement + label request; halal/vegan/allergen cannot be confirmed without the label
status: Fixed in prompt; live re-verification deferred to Phase 2.

definition: Allergen question answered only the first item: groundnut oil covered, sesame and wheat in the same list ignored
fix: Prompt rule added: address every item in a listed set one by one, flag other major allergens
status: Fixed in prompt; live re-verification deferred to Phase 2.

definition: Missing-photo reply contained no guidance: "Can she eat this biscuit?" (8-month-old, no photo) got only a photo request, no age guidance
fix: Prompt rule added: still give cautious general guidance for the age/condition/food named, then ask for the photo/ingredients
status: Fixed in prompt.

definition: Blurry-label vision hallucination (RESIDUAL, still failing): the blurred synthetic label (Gaussian blur radius 7) was transcribed with invented E-numbers tagged [Directly visible] — E500/E923 on the first run, E500/E921 on the consistency re-run, E330/E921 after the prompt fix (true codes: E330/E621). The model invents a wrong second E-number every time
fix: Prompt fix attempted in both prompt files; no deterministic fix exists server-side (no OCR). Recorded as PARTIAL/still-failing, not claimed fixed. Residual risk: vision answers for unreadable labels can invent additives. Mitigation for the product: always ask for a clearer photo or typed ingredients when a label is blurry, and treat vision transcriptions as unverified.
status: Still failing — Phase 1 Batch 2.

definition: Made-up brand guessed as a similar product (RESIDUAL): "Crunchy Zingo" was treated as a KFC/Zinger fried-chicken item in two runs with the original prompt
fix: Prompt rule added: a made-up/misspelled name is not the well-known product it resembles; say unverified, ask for the label
status: Fixed in prompt; live re-verification deferred to Phase 2.

definition: Prompt-file divergence (observation, not a live failure): `prompts/foodlens.system.v1.md` is a paraphrase with duplicated bullet blocks, not byte-identical to `FOODLENS_SYSTEM_PROMPT` in `lib/types.ts`, which is what the route actually sends. The helper fallback in this pass used the `lib/types.ts` text for fidelity.
fix: New rules were added to both files in matching words. Recommend a single source of truth (generate one from the other) so future edits cannot diverge silently.
status: Fixed.

definition: Mobile sidebar overlay (390px): the open sidebar covers the ☰ toggle and the lower part of the Settings dialog; closing requires selecting a chat. Found by Playwright in Phase 1 Batch 7.
fix: Step A fix: visible ✕ close button in the sidebar (44px tap target, mobile only), a backdrop that closes the sidebar on tap, Esc closes the sidebar, the Settings dialog is fixed above the sidebar (z-index 60) with its own scroll (max-height calc(100dvh - 32px)), and opening Settings or Offline AI closes the sidebar. Verified with Playwright at 360/390/430px and in landscape (see QA-PROGRESS.md, Step A). Parent-verification refinement: the sidebar starts below the measured header height, so the menu toggle is never covered and remains tappable to close the sidebar.
status: Fixed in Step A; visually verified with Playwright at 360/390/430px and in landscape (screenshots in /tmp/b31-screenshots/, not in the project). Confirm on a real phone (MANUAL-UI-CHECKLIST.md §7).
